integrity: Complete proof, independent exact coefficient and evaluation enumerations, branch tests and F49 point counts embedded; no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth genus-two curves over F7 are classified; established upper bound is not new. Earlier unpublished small-field genus-two classifications may give implicit prior coverage. Counting programs provide exhaustive finite certificates, not a theorem for general fields.
title: Two sixteen-point genus-two curves over \(\mathbf F_7\)
